acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

cleavage_agent.evidence: Sample preparation for reduction, alkylation, trypsin digestion, and cleanup were performed according to the EasyPep protocol.

fractionation_method.value: Pierce High pH Reversed-Phase Fractionation Kits
fractionation_method.evidence: Pierce High pH Reversed-Phase Fractionation Kits were used to fractionate TMT-labeled digest samples into eight fractions by an increasing aceto-nitrile step-gradient elution.

ionization_type.evidence: One μg of each sample was subjected to nano-Liquid Chromatography coupled to Electrospray Ionization Tandem Mass Spectrometry using a nano Easy 100 (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Waltham, MA, USA) coupled online to an Q Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: coupled online to an Q Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
